content: We tokenized English and Russian sentences using tokenizer.perl of Moses BIBREF3 . To tokenize Japanese sentences, we used MeCab with the IPA dictionary. After tokenization, we eliminated duplicated sentence pairs and sentences with more than 100 tokens for all the languages.
